description: ping portable output: Flow Weaver's field set is the contract — success, rtt_avg_ms, packets_sent, packets_received, raw_output — plus packet_loss, derived from the pair and SHOULD be emitted beside it. Products may add fields; they may not rename or remove these. The probe is aimed at a closed loopback port, so the unreachable path is what is measured: a TCP prober reports ONE attempt, so packets_sent is 1 and packets_received is 0.
notes: fields-present compares the presence and TYPE of each name, never the numbers, which are a property of the probe and not of the contract. The earlier draft of this document specified an invented quartet (reachable/latency_ms/method/host) that the oracle never emitted; those four are implementation extensions and are deliberately not asserted here.
